text_block_list.text:
Going to retrieve something left behind at the dance studio,
I found Haru Urara having a blast
during her solo practice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —And that's that! Phew~ brings back memories~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, you came!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, when I was little, I used to dance a lot
in the workshop at home~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it came back to me while I was dancing!
Everyone made a microphone out of wood for me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, on the day I entered the
academy, they wrote 'Do your best!' on a huge
cloth for me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: “They promised they'd bring that and all come see my concert together! We made a promise!”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to practice hard for the live too!
I can't go letting everyone down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I figured I'd better practice, right!

Haru Urara hastily resumed her live practice.
She flubbed the lyrics here and there, but it was
a wonderful, heartwarming performance nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how was it!?
Do you think everyone will like it!?
choice_data_list: If you memorize the lyrics properly, you'll get even better!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it!
I had a feeling that was the case!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When I pictured that 'Good Luck!' banner at the venue,
it gave me so much strength to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So when the real thing comes, I'm sure
I can try eveeeen harder! Ehehe!

Full of enthusiasm, she continued practicing afterward,
polishing the live performance to be even more cheerful and bright.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see! True, I might've forgotten
the lyrics from time to time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, if we can memorize all the lyrics perfectly,
it's definitely gonna be an even more amazing live!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then, I wonder if everyone who comes to watch
will be super surprised~!? Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All riiiight, I'll do my best to memorize it!
Having memorized the lyrics perfectly, her feelings resonated through her singing voice, shaping the performance into a truly wonderful concert.
